requirements.title: A customer can pay with a card
requirements.description: The checkout accepts a valid card and confirms the order. A card that is declined shows why and keeps the cart.

requirements.title: The checkout can be used with a keyboard and a screen reader
requirements.description: Every control in the checkout is reachable by keyboard, has an accessible name, and the focus order follows the visual order.

requirements.title: The checkout works on a phone and a tablet
requirements.description: No content is cut off or needs sideways scrolling, and every control can be used by touch.

requirements.title: Card numbers are never stored or logged
requirements.description: Card data goes straight to the payment provider. It does not appear in logs, URLs or local storage.

requirements.title: A discount code reduces the total by its percentage
requirements.description: SAVE10 takes 10 % off the order total, and never more than the total itself.
